# `diff-run` command

Run the declared cases on a git revision and on the working tree, both in scratch copies, and compare their
quantities.

```bash
fobis diff-run [REF] [CASE...] [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Verifying results](/cookbook/verification).

## All options

Arguments: `REF NAMES...`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Select a mode defined into a fobos file |
| `--assess` |  |  | Judge a difference against the working tree's own spread (fobis assess families). |
| `--keep` |  |  | Keep the scratch copies (path printed). |
| `--runner` | TEXT | `local` | Where the programs run: local, or slurm (jobs submitted with sbatch; [scheduler] settings). |
| `--json` |  |  | Emit structured JSON to stdout instead of human-readable output (useful for scripting / agents) |

<!-- cli:end -->
